ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the section heading. Formatted text and links are allowed.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Use these cards to review industry-specific assumptions before final publication.

Cards.helper: Add feature items in display order. Image is optional; a soft placeholder is shown when no image is selected.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the card title. Formatted text and links are allowed.

Title.helper: Required. Card title. Formatted text and links are allowed.

Description.helper: Required. Supporting body copy. Formatted text and links are allowed.
Description.placeholder: Placeholder for mission and program environments where final language must be reviewed for compliance, procurement, and claim sensitivity.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Image.helper: Optional. Landscape image shown in the active visual panel. Leave empty to render the built-in placeholder.

ImageAltText.helper: Optional. Describe the card image when the image communicates meaning. Leave empty for decorative imagery.
